column1: # Suhalla interiors: Iodem questions the wounded soldiers after Babi's audience.

column3: Iodem...{end_wait}
You were ordered to\nescort the party back\nto Lalivero.{end_wait}
Iodem... What are\nyou doing here?{end_wait}
Babi ordered me to go\nto the lighthouse with\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You were escorting\n{actor_name:7} to Lalivero,\nweren't you?{end_wait}
We have disgraced\nTolbi...{end_wait}
What happened to\n{actor_name:7}? Where is\n{actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
We do not know. When we\nwoke, we were here\nin these beds.{end_wait}
If {actor_name:7} was harmed,\nwhat becomes of the\nlighthouse?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} was the reason\nLalivero agreed to help\nbuild it.{end_wait}
We placed {actor_name:7}\nin your care. Her safety\nwas your duty.{page_break}Tell me how you lost her.{end_wait}
Iodem...{pause_20_skippable} She was not\nwith us when the storm\nstruck.{end_wait}
Are you certain?{end_wait}
We kept {actor_name:7} away\nfrom the worst of it.\nThen we were separated.{end_wait}
Then you did what you\ncould. But where is\n{actor_name:7} now?{end_wait}
Near the edge of the\nsandstorm that struck us...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, we must search\nthe desert and find\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
If you return to the\ndesert, beware that\ncyclone!{end_wait}
At first{pause_20_skippable}, we could not\nescape the sandstorms.{end_wait}
But others crossed\nthose storms without\nbeing caught.{end_wait}
They used water to\nforce the cyclones\nto break.{end_wait}
Water can stop the\nsandstorms...?{end_wait}
I see. Rest now.\nYou have done enough.{end_wait}
Wait, Iodem...{pause_20_skippable} There is\nmore. Do not meet\nour fate...{end_wait}
The sandstorms{pause_20_skippable} are\ncaused{pause_20_skippable} by monsters.{end_wait}
Monsters?{end_wait}
The others...{pause_20_skippable} They slew\nthe beasts{pause_20_skippable}... That is\nhow they crossed.{end_wait}
Who were those people?\nWhat did you see?{end_wait}
When the storms stopped,\nthey moved ahead,{pause_20_skippable}\nbut another storm rose...{end_wait}
They had strange powers.\nWe carried barrels of\nwater...{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
The water ran out...\nThen the creature came.\nWe could not stop it.{end_wait}
Enough. Get some rest.\nWe will take it from here.{end_wait}
They are dangerous.\nSlay the beast, then\nfollow their trail...{end_wait}
You survived. That is\nenough for now. Rest.{end_wait}
Could these be the ones\nyou are following,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
You reached the same\nconclusion from their\naccount...{end_wait}
I cannot explain it,\nbut something in their\nstory tells me so...{end_wait}
We must find {actor_name:7}\nas quickly as we can!{end_wait}
